terms.meaning: a round control where only one option in its group can be selected at a time

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Choice group and round option
sections.what: Creates the column that holds the choices and the round button for each one, with a filled dot shown when it is chosen.
sections.why: Likely reason: the dot is drawn as an icon so it matches the app's icon style.
sections.watch_out: The dot is an icon, so the icon library must be installed for it to appear.

summary: Provides a set of choices where the user picks exactly one option, shown as round dots.
purpose: Lets a form ask the user to choose one option from a short list.
why: Likely reason: it wraps a library that handles keyboard and screen reader behaviour and adds the app's styling.
how: The group is a column of evenly spaced rows. Each item is a small round button that shows a filled dot when selected. Clicks and arrow-key moves are handled by the library.
inputs: Options, the current value and a change handler passed as props, plus style overrides.
outputs: A group of radio buttons, reporting which one is chosen.
risks: No item looks selected unless the parent supplies a value. Each item needs a unique value or choices will clash.
debug: If no dot appears when an option is chosen, check that the group value matches an item value exactly.
